Filter

Source: vignettes/articles/r-docs/filter.Rmd
filter.Rmd

Basic Example

Trace transforms (including filter) were removed from plotly.js, so filter the data in R and plot the result.

library(plotly.core)

cars <- mtcars[mtcars$qsec > mean(mtcars$qsec), ]

go_figure() |>
  add_scatter(
    x = cars$hp,
    y = cars$qsec,
    text = rownames(cars),
    hoverinfo = "text",
    mode = "markers"
  )

Reference

See go_scatter() for more information and options!
